messages:
maria: Heads-up: external pen test scheduled for 2026-04-05. Need a short runbook covering RBAC changes, KMS access, audit log retention/export, and retest coordination. Who can lead intake + retest logistics?

sam (sec-eng-lead): I can take overall coordination. Quick wins: define scope, agree evidence window, ephemeral assessor roles, and KMS proxy path. Proposed timeline: pre-PT sync 2026-03-26, test window 2026-04-05 to 04-07, retest window 2026-04-12 to 04-14.

devops_jay: I'll own KMS pieces. Plan is to create a dedicated CMK for the assessment with scoped grants. For staging we can use the `aws-kms-proxy` pattern. @maria can you confirm which S3 buckets hold raw logs so I can craft the bucket policy?

alice (platform): For RBAC, recommend a timebound Okta group `pt-assessors` and SCIM mapping to the platform role that only grants read/list on runtime and logs. Will open a Jira for SCIM rule change. Example policy snippet for the platform role:
```json
{
  "Version": "2022-01-01",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["logs:DescribeLogGroups", "logs:GetLogEvents"], "Resource": "arn:aws:logs:us-east-1:123456789012:log-group:/redwood/*"}
  ]
}
```

oncall-bot: Added `eng-sre` to thread and set reminder for pre-PT sync on 2026-03-26.

sarah (eng-sre): We can provide read-only access to logs via time-limited pre-signed S3 URLs and STS-assumed roles for anything that needs console access. Question: what retention window should we expose for evidence? Full raw logs might be sensitive.

paul (compliance): Compliance requires a 90-day immutable audit trail for anything tied to user auth and admin actions. Evidence package for retest must include PRs, commit SHAs, deploy timestamps, and an exported log slice. Prefer WORM export where possible.

maria: 90 days sounds right. For the retest we need sign-off from Sec Eng + Product Security before we roll the fixes to prod and schedule the retest. Also flag: ensure inference endpoints do not leak model weights or debug-level traces in logs.

devops_jay: Noted on redaction. We'll turn on redaction rules in the logging pipeline (Lambda filter + kinesis). I'll also draft the KMS grant command we plan to use in staging:
```bash
aws kms create-grant --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/aaaa-bbbb-cccc \
  --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor-role \
  --operations Encrypt Decrypt GenerateDataKey
```

alice (platform): I'll create the Jira epic and link the tickets: RBAC change, KMS grant, log export job, evidence packaging. Will set timebound membership for `pt-assessors`.

sam (sec-eng-lead): Owners: @devops_jay -> KMS, @alice (platform) -> RBAC/SCIM, @sarah -> logs/exports. I'll own coordination and retest signoff. Please add availability for the pre-PT sync on 3/26. :thumbsup:

maria: Also add a checklist item: validate that private model artifacts are NOT included in logs or S3 exports. If there is any debug dump that contains model protobufs, block exports until redaction.

devops_jay: We'll scan for artifact-like filenames in logs and exclude them from exports. I'll add a grep-based pre-export check to the runbook.

sarah (eng-sre): I'll draft a concise runbook snippet and post by EOW with the export commands and checklist.

alice (platform): Jira epic created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PT-4112. Linking tickets now.

sam (sec-eng-lead): Nice. For the retest acceptance criteria: 1) remediation PR merged + tests passing, 2) deployment to prod-dedicated or staging depending on severity, 3) evidence bundle uploaded to the PT ticket (logs, PR, SHA, deploy time). We'll keep retest slots flexible but prefer the 4/12-4/14 range.

paul (compliance): Add: include KMS audit logs (CloudTrail events for Encrypt/Decrypt/GrantCreate) in the evidence package. Those events are required to prove that access was scoped.

maria: Thanks all. Action items: 
- devops_jay: draft KMS grant + proxy plan
- alice: RBAC SCIM change + Jira tickets
- sarah: log export/runbook snippet + pre-export checks
- sam: schedule pre-PT sync and owner signoffs
We'll reconvene in the pre-PT meeting. If anyone needs access to the thread, ping me. ✅
